label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee for the mayor in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with eight lanterns and 200 fresh feast loaves, fifty per table. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated; baker knowingly supplied and verified the bread and kept the surprise confidential. The mayor was given an inn-service meeting as the reason for attending. No evidence that neighbour knowingly helped; secretary scheduled the meeting and overheard some revealing talk, but knowing assistance in the surprise is not established.
